issues.problem: Id pinning plus the live loop mixes two agencies' records in a bundle's summary. When a California fire is built under its NIFC WFIGS id and CAL FIRE lists it later, the merged row keeps the WFIGS id but becomes CAL FIRE's record. The live loop's sync (SUMMARY_SYNC_FIELDS) then copies CAL FIRE's acres, update time and URL into the bundle's manifest summary. That summary keeps record_source 'wfigs', record_issuer '<CODE> via NIFC WFIGS' and the IRWIN uid. So the official numbers and the link are shown under the wrong issuer.
issues.evidence: live.summary_changes(bundle summary of a WFIGS row, pinned CAL FIRE row of the same id) syncs ['acres', 'active_sources', 'updated_ms', 'url'] only. The bundle summary afterwards reads record_source 'wfigs', record_issuer 'CAL FIRE via NIFC WFIGS', uid = IRWIN, url = https://www.fire.ca.gov/incidents/..., acres 60 (CAL FIRE's). web/src/ui/EvidenceTab.tsx:198-200 labels manifest.summary.url with recordIssuerLabel(manifest.summary). pipeline.refresh_live (pipeline.py:796) also reads m['summary'] when it writes the issuer text.
issues.fix: In sync_live_summaries / summary_changes, when the fresh row's record_source or uid differs from the bundle summary's (a pinned row), also copy the record-identity fields: record_source, record_issuer, uid, calfire_uid, agency, agency_code, unique_fire_id, source_name, aliases and name. The id stays. Add a regression test on the id-pinning before/after pair in tests/test_us_catalog_list.py: after one sync, the issuer, uid and url all come from CAL FIRE.

issues.problem: display_name title-cases the letters after an apostrophe, so ALL-CAPS WFIGS names with a possessive read wrongly in the list, the cards and the headings.
issues.evidence: display_name("DEVIL'S CANYON") -> "Devil'S Canyon"; "0501 PAT'S CABIN" -> "0501 Pat'S Cabin"; "JOHNSON'S" -> "Johnson'S". Both 2026 names are in the live 2026 list (ids 2026-devil-s-canyon-23e897, 2026-0501-pat-s-cabin-6c4551).
issues.fix: Lower-case a short run after an apostrophe ('s', 't', 'd', 'll', 're', 've') and keep "O'Neil" for longer runs. Add those cases to test_display_names_and_tokens. Ids do not change, because the slug is lower case.

issues.problem: Take a CAL FIRE row (not a complex) that is matched to two or more WFIGS records, none with the same name. Its irwin_id is null, so the incident record answers not_covered 'NIFC WFIGS has no record matched to this fire.', although other_records lists the matched NIFC WFIGS records. The words are true for the contract's case (no match) but misleading for this one.
issues.evidence: incident_record_payload: `irwin = s.irwin_id or ...; if not irwin: return _not_covered(body, REASON_NO_MATCH)`. enrich_calfire sets irwin_id None when there are several matched records and no single same-name one (documented deviation for Dale-like cases).
issues.fix: When s.other_records is non-empty and irwin_id is null, give a reason that says NIFC WFIGS lists the fire under several records, each linked from the fire's records. Record the wording as a contract deviation, or ask the integration to add it to §14.5.

issues.problem: This file is outside us-catalog (us-official, integration checklist item 2). On the national overview, the Official now block is still headed 'California' and says 'in California'. It shows the issue time of NWS alerts for Montana, South Dakota and Wyoming in Pacific time ('issued Oct 22, 18:38 PDT').
